dedupe_keys.name: syria ministry of health hospitals beds infrastructure and operational status 2023

description: This table lists the public hospitals run by Syria's Ministry of Health with their beds and their physical and operational condition. The producer is the ministry's Directorate of Planning and International Cooperation, and the file is published on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. Coverage is national as of 30 September 2023, with more than 120 hospitals grouped by governorate. For each hospital it gives the name in English and Arabic, address and phone, specialisation, the actual and theoretical number of beds, the infrastructure status such as undamaged or damaged, and the operational status such as functioning; a second sheet summarises hospitals by governorate. The file is available as a free XLSX download under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: it covers ministry hospitals only, not those in areas outside government control or run by other bodies, hospitals have addresses but no coordinates, and the snapshot predates later changes. Simulation uses: a baseline of hospital capacity and damage for conflict and earthquake scenarios, measuring the gap between theoretical and actual beds, and planning referral networks between governorates. Related records: the WHO attacks on health care data (data-ssa-public-health-facilities) and the explosive weapons events (data-ewipa-explosive-weapons-health-facilities) record damage to health facilities in Syria.
